notes: The first link is the compiler's own name, written in the text as its first transmitter; rule 13 writes him as an ordinary narrator. The tool also heads the chain with the compiler, so the archive should see the repeat.
«محمد بن أبي إسحاق (1) بن أحمد» — the footnote mark «(1)» is left out.
«عن أبيه» after «الحسن بن محمد المروزي» is a bare relation link.
«(رضي الله عنه)» and «(صلى الله عليه وآله)» are blessings and are left out. The «قيل: يا نبي الله» exchange inside the saying is passive, with no link.
